title: CARS Act Total-Payable Disclosure — CA-CARS-003
quote: Monthly payment advertised on vdp without the total amount payable over the term.
statute: Cal. Civ. Code §1784.41(c)(1) (CARS Act, SB 766) | CALIFORNIA controls: CARS Act (SB 766, Cal. Civ. Code §1784.20 et seq.), operative Oct 1, 2026. The federal FTC CARS Rule (16 CFR Part 463) was VACATED by the 5th Circuit (Jan 2025) and formally WITHDRAWN from the CFR (Fed. Reg. Feb 2026) — not enforceable. Subsection pin-cites verified against the chaptered statute (leginfo) 2026-06-28.
recommendation: California's CARS-style requirement is not operative until Oct 1, 2026 — fix now to be ready. This is a CALIFORNIA requirement, not a federal one. Under the CARS Act (operative Oct 1, 2026) any monthly-payment ad must also disclose the total the consumer will have paid after all scheduled payments.

title: Used-vehicle savings representation ('Dealer Discount' off 'List Price') lacks prior-price substantiation
quote: Price breakdown: List Price $35,995, Dealer Discount -$3,410, Doc Fee +$85, Selling Price $32,670
statute: CA Business & Professions Code §17501 (former/comparative price advertising)
recommendation: **NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW AND VERIFICATION** — The used VDP presents a 'Dealer Discount' deducted from a stated 'List Price,' which reads as a savings/former-price claim. §17501 requires that a compared-to price be the prevailing market price within the three months prior, or that the date it prevailed be stated. The breakdown is otherwise commendably transparent (line-itemized, $85 doc fee at the CA legal max, 'No Dealer Add-ons!'), so risk is low, but confirm the 'List Price' reflects a genuine prior asking price and consider adding an effective date or defining 'List Price' to remove ambiguity. Cannot be auto-verified because prior-price history is not visible on the page.

title: Used-vehicle savings representation ('Dealer Discount' off 'List Price') lacks prior-price substantiation

Presentation is transparent and low-risk, but confirm 'List Price' represents a genuine prior asking price or add a dated reference. Appears systemic across used VDPs, so a template-level fix would resolve all instances. Cannot be auto-verified from the page alone.
